messages:
Maya R (CS): Hi team — kickoff for the Solaris pilot next Wed. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a timeline. Quick poll: is 3pm PT ok?

Raj P (Solutions): 3pm PT works for me. Attendees I suggest: Maya, Raj, Chris, Tess, Omar, plus Alex from Solaris Eng. I’ll loop Alex in.

Chris L (Eng): Heads up — we should confirm the model variant (r-infer-v2) and whether they expect Private deployment or Hosted for the pilot. That changes the infra prep.

Tess G (CS AE): Solaris is evaluating Dedicated and Private long term but wants a Hosted pilot first. Renewal risk: they have a security review scheduled in ~6 weeks that could block Private.

Omar K (Solutions Eng): I can lead the tech kickoff. Action item: run infra checklist and confirm KMS/VPN prerequisites. Potential blockers: KMS access and customer firewall rules.

Maya R (CS): Proposed success criteria (please react): 1) P95 latency <= 300ms for core generation flow; 2) Sustained throughput ~100 req/s without errors; 3) Routing + fallback behavior verified under load; 4) 5 power users trained and able to run evals. Any additions?

Raj P (Solutions): Add: documented cost estimate per 1k tokens for their expected workload and an ops runbook for failover. Also include regression checks for output quality.

Chris L (Eng): Draft timeline (ETA from kickoff):
- Week 0: Kickoff, access provisioning, gather sample prompts
- Week 1: Test harness + baseline metrics
- Week 2: Pilot traffic (limited) + monitoring configured
- Week 3: Optimization (batching/quant) + validate SLOs
- Week 4: Handoff + enablement sessions

Tess G (CS AE): Enablement plan: product walkthrough (30m), Ops runbook walkthrough (45m), evaluation retrospective (30m). I’ll schedule those during Week 4.

Maya R (CS): Owners (proposed): Access & coordination — Tess; Test harness & metrics — Chris; Infra & KMS — Omar; Cost/runbooks — Raj; Enablement & customer success outcomes — Maya/Tess.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-04-05T09:00Z

Chris L (Eng): Major risk: security signoff timeline may slip. Mitigation: start with Hosted + data-masking and switch to Dedicated/Private once approved. Also prepare a rollback playbook.

Maya R (CS): Deliverables before kickoff: customer tech questionnaire completed, VPN and KMS details, list of sample prompts & evaluation criteria. Pls add items to the shared doc: https://rwd-internal.atlassian.org/solarispilot (edit access requested).

Tess G (CS AE): I’ll own collecting sample prompts and user persona details. @Chris L can you drop the harness template into the doc? Quick curl example for the customer: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"r-infer-v2","input":"<prompt>"}'
```

Chris L (Eng): Will add the harness template and a basic Prometheus dashboard JSON to the doc by EOD.

Maya R (CS): Next steps: I’ll send the calendar invite to attendees and attach the access checklist. If anyone sees other blockers, flag here. :thumbsup: 

Omar K (Solutions Eng): Noted — opening the KMS access ticket and checking firewall rules with infra.

Tess G (CS AE): :raised_hands:
